retain_rule: Retain initial model when every scheduled source execution verifies and across-seed average absolute discrepancies are <=20% for mean, <=25% for SD, <=0.15 for glucose Pearson r, and <=0.10 for age Pearson r. These are engineering diagnostic tolerances, not scientific validity thresholds. Inspect all secondary tertile diagnostics and disclose mismatch. Do not tune to one seed.
revision_rule: Only if primary rule fails, one scientific revision may correct a documented moment-derivation or source-context implementation error, or recalibrate intercept/residual variance from all three source draws; keep all initial results. If source approximation dominates, retain with limitation. No target information may select any parameter. A no-op final child binds feedback.
candidate_priority: Prefer the initial simple model unless a permitted source-only revision is justified. No target output summaries or target evaluation are used.
